justification: Sign-in failed for the owner twice: one-time email links were used by an email link scanner before the click. Standard: login page, auth callback, one redirect; no DB query.

pre_impl.existing_data: auth.flow_state: links sent 10:13:17 and 10:14:39 were used at 10:13:32 and 10:15:05; auth.users last_sign_in_at empty
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: A single-use link assumes the person is the first to open it; a mail scanner opens it first
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Every sign-in from deploy; the emailed link still works as before

functions.name: safeNext
functions.input: the next value from the sign-in page address bar
functions.output: a path on this site to return to after sign-in
functions.if_none: returns /reports when next is missing or leaves the site

functions.name: verifyCode
functions.input: the email address and the six digit code the person typed
functions.output: a signed-in session, then a move to the safe next path
functions.if_none: shows the Supabase error, or a send-a-new-code message when expired

values.read_at: login page nextPath and auth callback

break_it.scenario: An attacker sends a sign-in link with next=//evil.example
A mail scanner opens the emailed link first
break_it.what_happens: The link is used up but the typed code still signs the person in
break_it.repro: Send a code, let the email be scanned, type the code

break_it.scenario: The code is mistyped or expired
break_it.what_happens: Red message, Send a new code button

falsifiable_check.fails_when: safeNext returns next unchanged: the 4 off-site cases fail
falsifiable_check.observed_red: The callback used next unchecked before; the off-site cases would pass through

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes - add the {{ .Token }} code to the Supabase Magic Link email template, then sign in with the code
